[[Company Brain]] › Concepts › Safety rails

What [[Company Brain/awdiscord|awdiscord]] refuses to do, whatever the agent says.

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Rail
! Rule
|-
| '''Bot tokens only'''
| Every request is sent as <code>Authorization: Bot &lt;token&gt;</code>; the runtime asks Discord who owns the token first. A user account is refused, because driving a person’s account (a self-bot) breaks Discord’s terms
|-
| '''Least permission'''
| Install link asks for <code>bot</code> + <code>applications.commands</code> and four permissions: view channel, send messages, embed links, read message history. It refuses administrator, manage-server, manage-roles, manage-webhooks, ban, kick and mention-everyone
|-
| '''Rate limits'''
| Token buckets per user, per server and for the whole bot; a refusal says how long to wait
|-
| '''Mentions off'''
| Every answer goes out with <code>allowed_mentions: {parse: []}</code>, so an agent cannot ping <code>@everyone</code>
|-
| '''Approvals'''
| Operator-only buttons; see [[Company Brain/Approvals|Approvals]]
|-
| '''Who may use your model'''
| Only the home server and servers in <code>AWDISCORD_SERVED_GUILDS</code> reach your agent; others are told to [[Company Brain/Bring your own model|bring their own model]]
|-
| '''Secrets at rest'''
| Per-server API keys are written to a mode-600 file in a mode-700 directory, never to the database
|}
